metadata.founderNote: All seven documented PDFs are children of an unnamed common Guthrie patriarch. Their lineage codes are 1 (John), 2 (William), 5 (Stephen), 6 (Rachel), 7 (James), 8 (Absalom), A (Alexander). Codes 3, 4, 9 are unaccounted for and may represent siblings whose lines were never documented. The unnamed patriarch is recorded here as code '0' so all branches connect to a single root.

people.notes: Inferred common ancestor of the seven documented sibling branches. Gaps at codes 3, 4, and 9 suggest additional undocumented siblings.
